newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Suncorp-Metway unveils new bank strategy.
newsitem.headline: Suncorp-Metway unveils new bank strategy.

text.p: Queensland's new mega-bank Suncorp-Metway Ltd said on Tuesday it was building two separate companies within the group aimed at capturing large slices of both the insurance and banking sectors.
"One is our allfinanz company where our aim is to have six, eight or even 10 (financial) products per household that we serve," managing director Steve Jones told a media briefing.
"The other company we are building within our group is our small to medium size business banking to be known as Suncorp-Metway Business Bank," Jones said.
Jones also said the QIDC (Queensland Industry Development Corp) name would be retained as QIDC Agribusiness Banking, a division of the business banking company.
"We will strengthen our expertise in commercial property finance, property development, finance, leasing (cars and equipment) and agribusiness," he said.
"Suncorp-Metway will now be able to expand into towns which it didn't serve before by introducing new products and services through existing QIDC offices," he said.
"Over the next 12 months we will be working on the new logo, the new colour scheme and the new fit-out of our branches."
"All of our branches are to be converted to offer our full product line under the Suncorp-Metway brand name," Jones said.
A staff share ownership scheme had been also implemented with a grant of 100 Suncorp-Metway shares to those employed as at June 30 this year, Jones said.
Jones said lending in the business bank to owner-managed businesses would from under A$100,000 up to A$50 million.
"If you take that range of A$25,000 to A$50 million, you are able to serve the needs of 95 percent of Australian business," he said.
Jones also said the board's aim of achieving A$115 million in cost savings and efficiencies including A$40 million in performance improvements on an annual basis by June 30 was on track.
"We're on track so far and doing everything to stay on track," Jones said.
